```json
 "rationale": "The 1.52 V swing rules out cascodes, so I use a class-A two-stage Miller with high gm/Id output devices (Vdsat ~0.1 V each side). GBW=gm1/(2πCc): gm1≈240 µS with Cc=1.1 pF. With gm6≈1.4 mS (≈3·gm1·CL/Cc) and Rz≈2.5/gm6, the pole/zero cancellation gives PM above 70°. Long L gives ~68 dB of gain. Current budget is 10 µA ref + 30 µA tail + 95 µA output = 135 µA, about 245 µW. The large-area input pair keeps 1/f noise down."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 19.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (gain + flicker area)
    "Itail": (32e-6, 20e-6, 60e-6),  # tail current
    "gmidp": (13.0, 9.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror load + output CS (matched for low offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.35, 1.0),
    "gmidn": (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),      # NMOS bias mirror family (ibias diode, tail, output sink)
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I7":    (95e-6, 60e-6, 120e-6), # output stage current
    "Cc":    (1.1e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "kz":    (2.5, 1.2, 4.0),        # Rz = kz / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    Iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2

    # NMOS bias family (same gm/Id, L): ibias diode, tail, output sink
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Iref, vds=0.6)
    vb = mb.vgs
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # input pair (source ~0.2 V above vss -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.9, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and output CS device (same gm/Id and L -> matched Vgs)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.7)
    vsg3 = m3.vgs
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["kz"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)      # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)      # output side -> non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m3.cgd
    Co = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = gm6 * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * Cc + Co * Cc + C1 * Co))
    zden = Rz - 1.0 / gm6
    zl = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * zden) if zden > 0 else 1e15
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm_mirror = gm3 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / zl)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (2 * pm_mirror)))
    # CMRR ~ A1 * 2*gm3*ro_tail-ish
    cmrr = A1 * 2 * m3.gm / m5.gds
    psrr = A0 * 0.5
    power = vdd * (Iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    settle = 4.6 / (2 * PI * gbw) * 1.3 + 0.9 / slew
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * kT * (2.0 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = th * 12  # flicker dominated estimate at 1 kHz
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.04

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "psrr_db": db(psrr), "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}
```
